crossRefs.note: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who…
“Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;
You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to reason the cause with you. Why does the way of…
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

translations.web: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
translations.bsb: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
translations.kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
translations.asv: For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
